# Aastha Support

> Authentic, lab-certified, and Vedic-energised spiritual products — rudraksha, malas, bracelets, gemstones, yantras — plus live online poojas performed by learned pandits from Kashi, Ujjain and Haridwar.

Aastha Support sources rudraksha and gemstones directly from origin (Nepal, Indonesia, Sri Lanka), provides X-ray and lab certificates for every bead and stone, and energises products through traditional Vedic abhimantran rituals before pan-India dispatch. Free astrological consultation is offered with every order.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of collections, featured rudraksha, and trust signals.
- [About](/about): Story, sourcing, pandits, and Vedic certification process.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers on orders, rudraksha, gemstones, online pooja, shipping and returns.
- [Returns & Policies](/returns-policy): 7-day returns, shipping timelines, cancellation and privacy.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and Haridwar ashram address.

## Collections

- [Online Pooja](/category/online-pooja): Live Vedic rituals from Kashi, Ujjain & Haridwar.
- [Rudraksha](/category/rudraksha): Certified Indonesian and Nepali rudraksha (1 to 21 mukhi).
- [Mala](/category/mala): 108-bead malas for jaap and meditation.
- [Bracelets](/category/bracelets): Crystal and rudraksha bracelets for healing and protection.
- [Gemstones](/category/gemstones): Lab-certified Navratna gemstones with astrological guidance.
- [Yantra](/category/yantra): Sacred yantras energised with Vedic mantras.
